offering_description.value: Sells software that measures and verifies the quality of digital advertising for brands, agencies and publishers. It delivers the platform as a subscription or usage-priced service that tracks ad viewability, fraud, brand safety and performance across channels.

primary_products.value: ad verification platform; brand safety and suitability tools; ad fraud prevention; attention and viewability measurement

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers and brands, advertising agencies, publishers, digital media platforms

end_markets.value: digital advertising; media and publishing; retail; consumer packaged goods; financial services

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring platform access fees from advertisers and agencies; transaction or usage fees: fees based on ad impressions measured or verified

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: measurement and verification software sold to advertisers and publishers; service provider: campaign reporting and analytics services for agencies and brands

geography_served.value: global: operates in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: digital advertising measurement and verification

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to brands, agencies and publishers; partners / resellers: integrations with ad buying and ad tech platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and consumer data rules affecting tracking of ad users
